summary: Frontend-only test of VersionPoller red update banner on public /login page. Used Playwright page.route to mock GET /api/version. Verified: no banner on first load, banner appears after version change + visibilitychange/focus re-check, has correct testids (version-update-banner, version-refresh-button, version-banner-dismiss), is fixed top with z-index 9999 and red (rgb(220,38,38)) background with white text, and dismiss hides the banner. All 4 scenarios PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: VersionPoller correctly skips polling when document.visibilityState==='hidden' and re-checks on visibilitychange/focus — good UX.

dismissedVersion tracks initialVersion.current, which means the banner will re-appear only when a newer-than-initial version appears again; this is acceptable but note that if the user dismisses and then yet another new version lands, dismissedVersion still equals initialVersion, so the banner will show for the newer version — which matches the intended behavior per the comment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VersionPoller uses axios client with baseURL=${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api. To mock, intercept '**/api/version' with page.route and fulfill JSON {version: ...}. Trigger immediate re-check by dispatching visibilitychange + focus events. Do NOT click 'Refresh now' — it hard reloads.
